artworks.title: Standing Man in Sixteenth-Century Costume
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing with one arm outstretched in front and the other resting on their hip. The facial features are suggested with minimal details, and the hair is short and wavy. The person is wearing a tunic, sleeves, a garment that wraps around the shoulder, pants, and boots. The attire appears historical or theatrical. The figure is not holding any objects, and there is a plain background.

artworks.title: Four Cows
artworks.medium: red and black chalks with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four studies of cows. The image features various sketches of cows in different poses on a textured, neutral paper background. The top right figure depicts a standing cow with detailed musculature and horns, while the other three cows are shown reclining. Each sketch varies in detail, with some focusing on the overall form and others more concentrated on facial features and the texture of their bodies. The drawings utilize soft lines with shading to give the cows a lifelike appearance. The choice of red chalk against the tan paper adds a warm, natural tone to the portrayal.

artworks.title: Design for a Funeral Monument
artworks.medium: black chalk and stumping with touches of graphite, heightened with white, on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and curved shapes converging in an intricate and abstract composition. The central elements resemble classic statues, with two figures holding draped garments around a roundel displaying a profile of a classical head. Above them, a pedestal supports an urn wrapped in abstract, flowing lines. Below, a small cherubic figure similar to classical putti interacts with a scroll. The composition suggests a classical relief with an abstract quality that creates a dreamlike scene.

artworks.title: The Angry Mother
artworks.medium: black and gray wash over graphite on laid paper

artworks.title: Thomas Peyton
artworks.medium: pastel, graphite, and gouache on two sheets of adhered laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man's profile captured from the side. He has finely detailed features, a prominent nose, slightly arched eyebrows, and a neutral expression. The man has light-colored, smooth hair tied in a ponytail at the nape of his neck and is wearing a dark blue coat with a high collar and a light-colored vest with intricate fabric details. The painting has an elongated octagonal shape and the edges are secured with tape. The background is textured with dark and light blues. No visible jewelry or objects are held by the person in the portrait.

artworks.title: Lady Holland (Lady Mary Fitzpatrick)
artworks.medium: pastel with touches of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an oval portrait of a woman from the chest upwards. She is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The woman has delicate facial features and a youthful appearance, with dark hair styled in an elaborate updo typical of 18th-century fashion. She wears a gown with a low neckline and some white lace peeking out, in a muted brownish color. The background features a softly blended gradient of earthy tones. There are no visible accessories in the image.

artworks.title: Adolph Friedrich Theodor Gritzner
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body, including his torso and part of his right arm leaning on the back of a chair. He is seated in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly to his left. The man has curly, voluminous dark brown hair. His facial features include light blue eyes, arched eyebrows, and a half-smile. He is dressed in a formal, dark-colored coat with a high collar and is wearing a white shirt with a ruffled front. The man is holding a book in his right hand, which rests against the chair. The background is a neutral, soft gradient of darker tones.

artworks.title: Daniel Kemper
artworks.artist: American 19th Century, after Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on pink laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a side profile of a person, capturing the head and shoulders. The individual is facing right, with only the side of their face visible. The person has a defined nose, slightly pointed chin, calm lips, and hair pulled back. They are dressed in a traditional style with a high-collared garment, coat, and a cravat. The drawing has a simple background and an oval outline surrounding the subject.

artworks.title: Elizabeth Marius Kemper
artworks.artist: American 19th Century, after Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on pink laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view portrait of a woman facing left. Her features include a prominent nose, forehead, and chin. She wears a frilled cap with a bow, a lace-trimmed collar, and a necklace. The plain background has an oval vignette frame.

artworks.title: Title Cartouche for a Map of the Chateau and Village of Le Plessis aux Bois
artworks.medium: graphite, incised for transfer on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 8.1 x 9 cm (3 3/16 x 3 9/16 in.)
support: 28 x 19.7 cm (11 x 7 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative cartouche, intended for a map or architectural plan. The center features text that reads "PLAN DU CHATEAU ET VILLAGE DU PLESSIS AUX BOIS." The cartouche is adorned with various elements, including a crest at the top with a shield and accompanying figures on each side. Surrounding the text are two detailed figures in a contemplative pose, reminiscent of classical sculpture or mythology. The borders of the drawing have a thin red band and red triangular accents in the corners. The overall appearance suggests an ornate design meant to convey importance or elegance for the document it accompanies.

artworks.title: A Plinth Surmounted by the Arms of the King of France
artworks.medium: graphite, incised for transfer on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a classical pedestal with a decorative shield or crest at the top. The shield is rich in detail and appears heraldic in design. The pedestal is depicted in a simple architectural style with a rectangular base and elaborate edges. The sketch is done in pencil on light-colored paper, giving it a monochromatic and textured appearance. There is faint handwritten text on the pedestal's center and a red border framing the drawing.

artworks.title: The Parting of Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a large gathering of people and animals. The image shows many figures gathered in what appears to be a historical setting. Many individuals are carrying spears and flags. There are depictions of horses being ridden, and a figure in the foreground playing a drum. The background features classical architecture with columns, and a distant hilly landscape is visible on the left. The sky has light clouds and a few birds in flight. The scene is rendered in a monochrome palette with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Design for a Burgonet Helmet
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate and ornate design. The drawing features elaborate designs with detailed motifs such as mythical figures, swirling patterns, and architectural elements. At the center, there is an oval scene depicting two standing figures engaged in an interaction. Surrounding this central motif are intertwining filigrees with cherubic figures, foliage, and grotesque elements. The perimeter of the design is lined with a border featuring figures in various postures. The shading and line work give the drawing a three-dimensional quality, emphasizing the ornate craftsmanship of the design.

artworks.title: Two Studies of Virgil
artworks.medium: graphite on 5 joined sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two figures standing together. One figure is turned slightly to the side with defined facial features and short hair. The other figure stands facing the first, with hair possibly adorned and draped in flowing garments. Both figures are barefoot and there is minimal background detail, highlighting the grace and elegance of the human form.

artworks.title: Mendigos que se llevan solos en Bordeaux (Beggars Who Get about on Their Own in Bordeaux)
artworks.medium: black chalk on greenish laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a person sitting in a wheelchair that has two large wheels with spokes in the front and a smaller wheel in the back. The person's body is facing the left and their head is turned to the right as they lean slightly forward. Their features are sketched loosely, but they appear to have a beard and a partially open mouth. They wear a hat and a shirt with ragged edges, as well as plain dark pants. We can see their hands on their lap, and their legs appear to end at the knee. The background is plain paper, with some words written below the drawing.

artworks.title: Eight Apostles
artworks.medium: red chalk over stylus underdrawing and traces of leadpoint on laid paper, cut in two pieces and rejoined; laid down
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of several people facing the left, depicted from the chest up. The individuals are standing together in a group. Their hair is in a variety of styles, and they are dressed in draped garments. The person at the front of the group has their hands clasped together in front of their chest. The background is plain beige paper, and the lines of the drawing have been done in red.

artworks.title: A Marble Horse on the Quirinal Hill [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk and pen and brown ink, with stylus underdrawing and traces of leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse in a rearing position, captured in thin red lines against beige paper. The horse faces the right, its back legs only visible above the knees and its front legs raised into the air. Various measurements and annotations are visible, suggesting a study or preparatory work focusing on proportion and form. The horse's mouth is open, and its mane and tail have been cut short.

artworks.title: Architectural Details and a Soldier [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements and a figure sketch. The drawing features three distinct sections. On the left side, there is a sketch of a classical architectural element resembling a frieze or wall relief with three human figures standing between columns. In the center, there is a cylindrical structure that appears to be a pedestal or part of a column, adorned with decorative elements and labeled with numerical annotations. To the right, there is a loosely sketched figure wearing a helmet, possibly of a classical warrior or soldier, rendered in profile and holding a small object. The drawing is executed with fine, precise lines typical of a study or preliminary work, likely for a larger architectural or artistic project.

artworks.title: The Virgin Annunciate
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray washes over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures gathered closely around a woman holding a baby. The woman is seated on the left, looking down at the baby in her lap. Beside them, a man leans forward, touching their hands. Other men surround them, observing the scene. The background is simple, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: View of Houtewael near the Sint Anthoniespoort [recto]
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash and touches of white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, with windmills, buildings, and trees in the distance. In the foreground, there are outlines of grassy terrain and a wooden structure. The brushstrokes are sparse, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette is subdued, primarily sepia tones with hints of gray and brown. The sky above is an open expanse of lightly textured paper.

artworks.title: Figures on the Anthoniesdijk Entering Houtewael [verso]
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink on light brown washed laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch with a viewpoint from a distance at eye level. The horizon is subtly drawn across the composition with small structures, likely houses, placed along it. These buildings are positioned towards the center and right-hand side. The lines are light and somewhat sketchy, capturing an impression rather than detailed features. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by earthy brown and dark gray tones. A path leads towards the buildings with figures standing in a group and one seated. Trees are scattered among the buildings, drawn with simple strokes. The background is mostly empty, drawing focus to the central scene.

artworks.title: Studies of Saint Francis Kneeling and Other Figures
artworks.medium: brown wash heightened with white on green prepared paper, cut, reassembled, and laid down
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 40.9 x 24.8 cm (16 1/8 x 9 3/4 in.)
support: 43.2 x 27 cm (17 x 10 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped figures in motion. The drawing features sketches on a pale green background, depicting flowing garments and hints of figures. The lines are energetic and dynamic, suggesting movement. The figures are rendered in white, using strokes to suggest contours and folds in the fabric. Two ornate scroll shapes frame the central image, each containing inscriptions. The drawing conveys a rhythmic harmony in the arrangement of shapes and lines.

artworks.title: Initial Q with a Procession of Children
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on parchment
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
